self: A feather brushes slowly across your left thumb.
A fingertip presses firmly into your left thumb and holds there.
A warm palm rests gently on your left thumb; the heat soaks in.
An ice cube touches your left thumb, cold and wet, then slides away.
Something tickles your left thumb, quick and light, again and again.
A soft paintbrush is drawn along your left thumb, bristles cool and dry.
There is a single light tap on your left thumb, then nothing.
A drop of warm water lands on your left thumb and slowly runs off.
